opex.text: We believe that our existing cash and cash equivalents will be sufficient to fund our operating expenses, working capital and capital expenditure requirements for at least twelve months from the date of issuance of the condensed consolidated financial statements included in this Quarterly Report. We have based this estimate on assumptions that may prove to be wrong, and we could exhaust our available capital resources sooner than we expect. We will require substantial additional funding to complete development of our pulsed laser and fusion energy technologies and to commercialize any resulting products, and we may seek such funding through equity or debt financings, government contracts and grants, or strategic collaborations. Such funding may not be available on acceptable terms, or at all.

rd.heading: Research and Development Expenses
rd.text:
Research and development expenses consist primarily of costs incurred in connection with the design, prototyping, and testing of BLF’s pulsed laser architecture and related fusion energy and directed energy applications. These expenses include personnel-related costs (including stock-based compensation) for engineering and scientific staff, materials and components consumed in laboratory and prototype activities, fees paid to research collaborators and third-party service providers, depreciation and facility costs allocated to R&D operations, and other costs that support BLF’s R&D programs.

BLF expenses research and development costs as incurred. BLF expects research and development expenses to fluctuate from period to period based on the timing and scope of prototype builds, hardware demonstrations, and external research engagements, and to increase over the long term as BLF advances its technology toward commercial deployment.

ga.heading: General and Administrative Expenses
ga.text:
General and administrative expenses consist primarily of salaries and employee-related costs, including stock-based compensation, for personnel in executive, finance, and other administrative functions. Other significant costs include facilities-related expenses not included in research and development expense, legal fees related to intellectual property and corporate matters, other professional fees for accounting and consulting services, insurance, and other administrative expenses.

BLF expects that its general and administrative expense will increase for the foreseeable future as it continues to support its expanding headcount and operations to support the growth of its business. Following the Merger, BLF also expects increased expenses related to audit, legal, regulatory and tax-related services associated with maintaining compliance with exchange listing and SEC requirements, director and officer insurance premiums, board of director fees, investor relations costs and other expenses that it did not incur as a private company.

nonop.heading: Other Income (Expense)
nonop.text: Other income (expense) consists of interest earned on our cash and cash equivalents, primarily money market funds. It also includes foreign currency gains and losses related to our Japanese subsidiary and our yen-denominated lease liability.

tax.heading: Income Taxes
tax.text: Income tax expense consists of foreign income taxes incurred by our Japanese subsidiary, Blue Laser Fusion GK. BLF has historically incurred net losses and maintains a full valuation allowance against its U.S. federal and state net deferred tax assets.

net.text: Our net losses were $2.0 million and $2.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively, and $6.5 million and $7.4 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively. As of September 30, 2026, we had an accumulated deficit of $27.6 million. Substantially all of our net losses have resulted from costs incurred in connection with our research and development programs and, to a lesser extent, from general and administrative costs associated with our operations.

ocf.heading: Operating Activities
ocf.text: Net cash used in operating activities was $6.4 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $7.3 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025, a decrease of $1.0 million. The decrease was primarily due to our $1.0 million lower net loss and $0.3 million of higher stock-based compensation expense, partially offset by a $0.3 million increase in prepaid expenses and other current assets in 2026, compared to a $0.1 million decrease in 2025. Changes in accounts payable and accrued expenses used net cash of $0.3 million in each of 2026 and 2025.

net sales.heading: Revenue
net sales.text: To date, BLF has generated limited revenue from licensing arrangements. Our revenue to date has been derived from licensing our proprietary radiation-hydrodynamics simulation software to a research institution in Japan. Under a twelve-month Software License and Service Agreement that commenced on April 1, 2026 (the “2026 Agreement”), we recognize total fixed consideration of approximately $0.1 million ratably over the term as a single combined performance obligation. We recognized revenue of $28 thousand and $57 thousand for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively, and no revenue for the corresponding periods in 2025. BLF has not generated any revenue from collaboration arrangements during the periods presented. BLF does not expect to generate material recurring revenue unless and until it successfully commercializes its directed energy and fusion energy products.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
